description_en: Assigns one or more IPv6 addresses to an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
description_zh: 为弹性网卡分配一个或多个IPv6地址
kebab_example: aliyun ecs assign-ipv6-addresses --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-interface-id eni-bp1iqejowblx6h8j0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssignIpv6Addresses

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡所在地域的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of IPv6 addresses to randomly generate for the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). Valid values: 1 to 10.

When you invoke this operation, you must set either the `Ipv6Addresses.N` parameter or the `Ipv6AddressCount` parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
为弹性网卡指定随机生成的IPv6地址数量。取值范围：1~10。

调用该接口时，您必须设置`Ipv6Addresses.N`参数或者`Ipv6AddressCount`参数的其中一个，但不能同时设置这两个参数
parameters.name: ipv6_address_count

parameters.help_en:
One or more IPv6 addresses to assign to the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). You can set up to 10 IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

Example: Ipv6Address.1=2001:db8:1234:1a00::\\

When you invoke this operation, you must set either the `Ipv6Addresses.N` parameter or the `Ipv6AddressCount` parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
为弹性网卡指定一个或多个IPv6地址。支持设置最多10个IPv6地址，即N的取值范围：1~10。

取值示例：Ipv6Address.1=2001:db8:1234:1a00::\\

调用该接口时，您必须设置`Ipv6Addresses.N`参数或者`Ipv6AddressCount`参数的其中一个，但不能同时设置这两个参数
parameters.name: ipv6_address

parameters.help_en:
One or more IPv6 prefixes to assign to the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). Valid values of N: 1 to 10.
If you want to set IPv6 prefixes for the ENI, you must set either the Ipv6Prefix.N parameter or the Ipv6PrefixCount parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
为弹性网卡指定一个或多个IPv6前缀。N的取值范围：1~10。
如果您需要为弹性网卡设置IPv6前缀，则必须设置Ipv6Prefix.N或者Ipv6PrefixCount的其中一个，但不能同时设置这两个参数
parameters.name: ipv6_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The number of IPv6 prefixes to assign to the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). Valid values: 1 to 10.
If you want to set IPv6 prefixes for the ENI, you must set either the Ipv6Prefix.N parameter or the Ipv6PrefixCount parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
为弹性网卡指定一个或多个IPv6前缀。取值范围：1~10。
如果您需要为弹性网卡设置IPv6前缀，则必须设置Ipv6Prefix.N或者Ipv6PrefixCount的其中一个，但不能同时设置这两个参数
parameters.name: ipv6_prefix_count

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

NetworkInterfaceId.description_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC)
